items.title: Ryanair Now Withholds Free Seats Until Just Before Departure, Blames Customer Feedback
items.why: Airlines tightening free seat perks may shift the value of seat-related benefits on airline co-brand cards.
items.summary_ai: Ryanair now assigns free seats only three to four hours before departure, citing customer feedback.
items.take: Airlines tightening free seat perks may shift the value of seat-related benefits on airline co-brand cards.

items.title: Why I’ll Never Fly Ryanair, Even If It’s The Only Option
items.why: A travel blogger explains why they vowed to avoid Ryanair, citing remote airports, outdoor boarding and high daytime fares.
